events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Today, we celebrate the 87th birthday of legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers.

angles.name: Cleese's Comedy Legacy
angles.copy: From silly walks to hotel mayhem, John Cleese has given us some of the most iconic comedy moments in history. Join us in wishing the legend a very happy 87th!

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their eponymous double album, widely known as 'The White Album', featuring iconic tracks like 'Back in the U.S.S.R.' and 'While My Guitar Gently Weeps'.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles gave us the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. Which track from the double LP still gets your attention?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 years old.

angles.name: Freddie's Enduring Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence continue to electrify generations. He would have been 80 today. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', showcasing a new lyrical maturity and musical experimentation.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Evolution
angles.copy: A true game-changer! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived 61 years ago today, pushing boundaries and redefining pop. What's your go-to track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon, who would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: 46 years on, we remember John Lennon, a visionary artist whose music and message continue to inspire. He would have been 86 today.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today, we celebrate what would have been the 80th birthday of the legendary David Bowie, a true innovator in music, fashion, and art.

angles.name: Bowie's Starman Legacy
angles.copy: Celebrating the Stardust legacy of David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. His influence on music and culture is truly immeasurable. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 92nd birthday of the King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: The King's Enduring Reign
angles.copy: Still shaking up the airwaves! Celebrating what would have been the 92nd birthday of Elvis Presley, the undeniable King of Rock & Roll.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to guitar icon Jimmy Page, best known as the founder and guitarist of Led Zeppelin.

angles.name: Guitar God Turns 83
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock history. What's your all-time favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Today, we wish a very happy 82nd birthday to the distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart, rock and pop legend.

angles.name: Rod's Raspy Charm
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! His incredible career spans decades and genres. What's the Rod song that always gets you singing along?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 66th birthday to Suggs (Graham McPherson), the charismatic frontman of British ska legends Madness.

angles.name: Madness Frontman's Day
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to Suggs from Madness! Forever bringing the house of fun. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young, the British singer known for his soulful voice and 80s hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)'.

angles.name: Paul Young's Soulful Sound
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the brilliant Paul Young! His smooth vocals defined a decade. Which of his hits is still on your playlist?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Today, we celebrate what would have been the 81st birthday of the iconic Queen of Country, Dolly Parton.

angles.name: Dolly's Enduring Charm
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton, whose incredible spirit and music would have seen her turn 81 today. Her songs are timeless treasures.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That frontman and celebrated songwriter, Gary Barlow.

angles.name: Gary Barlow's Milestone
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to the incredible Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to his solo success, he's a true UK music legend. What's your favourite track he's written?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Happy 77th birthday to Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of international R&B and pop hits in the 70s and 80s.

angles.name: Billy Ocean's Birthday Groove
angles.copy: Get out of our dreams and into our cars! Wishing a fantastic 77th birthday to the one and only Billy Ocean. What's your favourite song from him?

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony, honouring rock's pioneering legends.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: It was 38 years ago today the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame welcomed its very first inductees. Who do you think was the most deserving of that initial class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen, singer-songwriter and member of the iconic British group Take That.

angles.name: Take That's Mark Owen
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! From boyband heartthrob to solo artist, he's always entertained. What's your favourite Mark moment?

events.title: The Beatles' iconic Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Rock History
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert in London. What an unforgettable moment in music! Which track from that set is your favourite?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary drummer, singer, and songwriter Phil Collins, known for his work with Genesis and a hugely successful solo career.

angles.name: Phil Collins' Enduring Beat
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the iconic Phil Collins! His drumming and vocals have given us so many unforgettable songs. What's your favourite Phil Collins hit?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Happy 46th birthday to pop superstar, singer-songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake.

angles.name: JT's Birthday Groove
angles.copy: Bringing SexyBack for his 46th! Happy Birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake. What's your favourite JT track, solo or *NSYNC?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Today, we celebrate the 87th birthday of beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for his roles as Del Boy and Detective Jack Frost.

angles.name: National Treasure's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to national treasure Sir David Jason! From Peckham to Poplar, he's given us endless joy. What's your favourite David Jason character?

events.title: Anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died'
events.blurb: This day marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died' in 1959, when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Remembering Music Legends
angles.copy: 68 years ago today, we lost three music pioneers on 'The Day The Music Died'. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Their music lives on.
